text: This Motion recommends the release of a total of $579,558.47 in funds secured by the City through Section 37 Agreements for Bathurst Street intersection in Ward 20 as identified below. The amounts recommended to be budgeted include, where applicable, interest accrued while on deposit with the City. The redevelopment of the two properties (511 Bremner Boulevard (Block 37) and 500 Lake Shore Boulevard West) located opposite each other on the east side of Bathurst Street, north and south of Housey Street, respectfully, provides an opportunity to improve road safety and enhance the public realm in this area. The improvements will include the redesign of the intersection of Bathurst Street and Housey Street and the installation of traffic signals to provide a signalized crossing for pedestrians and cyclists using the Bentway and realignment of the sidewalks and boulevard areas on both sides…
